set.body:
Objective
Turn the audit standard into a repeatable closure gate so semantic regressions cannot hide behind successful knitting.

Required work
- Add or document a fresh-session renderer for all 11 vignettes.
- Run the suite twice to detect order and state sensitivity.
- Build the full pkgdown site and validate article navigation.
- Record and visually inspect every generated figure after the final render.
- Run all focused semantic tests introduced by the child slices.
- Record current HEAD, exact commands, timings, warnings, and any unrelated package-check limitations.

Acceptance criteria
- Two consecutive fresh-session all-vignette passes.
- A successful pkgdown article-site build with no missing or stale article links.
- Zero unexplained warnings, errors hidden by chunk options, or unsupported claims in the audited set.
- A compact verification receipt maps every epic finding to a test, rendered output, qualification, or explicit removal.
- The epic remains open until this gate passes at the exact candidate HEAD.
set.title: Add a repeatable full-vignette excellence and publication gate
